ऐक्षव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Sugar, sugary, produced from or relating to the
sugar-cane.
 E. इक्षु sugar-cane, अण् aff.

ऐक्षुक m. (-कः) A carrier of sugar-canes.
 E. इक्षु, and ठञ् aff.

ऐक्षुभारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carrying sugar-canes.
 E. इक्षु, and भार a load,
ठञ् aff.

ऐक्ष्वाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of the family of IKSHWAKU.
 E. ईक्ष्वाकु, and अञ्
affix, the final rejected.

ऐक्ष्वाकव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of the family of IKSHWAKU.
 E. ईक्ष्वाकु, and
अण् aff.
